description.tr: Galata Kulesi'nden yapay kanatlarla Boğaz'ı geçerek uçuş gerçekleştirdiği rivayet edilir || Uçuşu Evliyâ Çelebi'nin Seyahatnâme'sinde kayıtlıdır. || [Tarih notu] Tarihselliği tartışmalıdır — tek kaynağımız abartmasıyla bilinen Evliyâ Çelebi'dir.
description.en: Reportedly achieved a gliding flight across the Bosphorus from Galata Tower using artificial wings — one of history's earliest documented attempts at human flight || His flight is recorded by Evliya Celebi in the Seyahatname. While details may be embellished, the attempt reflects Ottoman interest in applied aerodynamics and the experimental spirit of 17th-century Istanbul. || [Historiographical note] The historicity is debated — our sole source is Evliya Celebi, known for exaggeration. However, the flight is consistent with contemporary gliding experiments elsewhere.
